subject: website
name: Swarm
summary: The main Swarm website. It stays at Level 2: when it opens it loads Matomo analytics from mtm.swarm.foundation and a Mautic form script from mautic.ethswarm.org, both without integrity hashes, and it reads node statistics from api.swarmscan.io. It also requests a video through bzz.link.

connections.name: Matomo analytics (mtm.swarm.foundation)
connections.note: Script and visit report loaded when the page opens, no integrity hash.

connections.name: Mautic forms (mautic.ethswarm.org)
connections.note: Script and stylesheet loaded when the page opens, no integrity hash.

connections.name: Swarmscan statistics (api.swarmscan.io)
connections.note: Node count read when the page opens.

connections.name: Swarm gateway (bzz.link)
connections.note: Hero video requested when the page opens.
